label: SECONDARY POST-BENCHMARK CAUSAL FOLLOW-UP -- attempts a minimal decoder-only fix so each Loghi sample is CTC-decoded with its own true post-network sequence length instead of the batch's uniform max. Does not modify GT, official predictions, crops, image preprocessing, beam width, or the pinned checkpoint/image.

mechanism_fix.root_cause_being_fixed: utils/decoding.py:decode_batch_predictions sets input_len = np.ones(pred.shape[0]) * pred.shape[1] -- every sample in a batch is CTC-decoded with the same sequence_length, equal to the batch's own max-width timestep count.
mechanism_fix.approach: Measure each sample's true content width directly from the actual input tensor (not re-derived from a resize/padding formula), since tf.data's padded_batch fills batch-added padding with the exact sentinel constant -10 (data/manager.py:_create_dataset), which real normalized image content never equals. A width column that is -10 across every height/channel position is unambiguously batch-added padding; batch padding is always a trailing suffix. Convert the resulting true content width to a timestep count via the confirmed 8x downsampling factor (3 stride-2 maxpool stages), clamp to [1, batch_timesteps], and pass this per-sample vector into decode_batch_predictions as sequence_lengths.

files_patched_via_readonly_bind_mount_no.change: decode_batch_predictions gains an optional sequence_lengths parameter; uses it in place of the uniform pred.shape[1] when provided. Behavior is unchanged when sequence_lengths is None.
DecodingWorker.run() and .stop() unpack a 5-tuple (added true_seq_lens) instead of 4, and pass sequence_lengths=true_seq_lens to decode_batch_predictions.

process_batches computes true_width per sample from the images tensor's -10 padding columns, maps to true_seq_lens via ceil(width/8) clamped to the batch's own timestep count, and includes it as a 5th element in the queue payload sent to decode workers.

mechanism_fix.container_image_unchanged: loghi/docker.htr:latest@sha256:414fc89ac574a61fd745836ad9852842759bf3cf7046e4549ae96315ff9132e8 (same pinned digest; patch files applied only via -v read-only bind mounts at container start, not baked into the image)
